level: per-variant cost ladder; L2 is the project's clinical level (ClinVar + gnomAD AF)
invocation: vep --fork 8 --json_cache <dir>, single process per cell, 3 reps per size
cache: gnomAD v4.1 GRCh38 joint AF>=1% blueprint, chr22 slices (the cuts job 1242 and the SnpEff clinical gate used)
note: 66 cells, all rc=0, every level's defining field asserted present. Answers the question job 1242 left open: vep-rs is only below break-even in its transcripts-only state. One genome-wide gnomAD source takes it from 7.42 to 31.95 us/variant, past even the legacy 29.7 us threshold, and every richer rung is further past it. See ANALYSIS.md for the fits and the two model caveats that matter.
